occurrences.text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
